about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

GOBSMACKED! is a chaotic multiplayer party game starring a gang of troublemaking goblins who couldn’t behave even if they tried. Whether you're flinging furniture, dangling from cranes, or smacking your mates off rooftops, expect total nonsense wrapped in physics-fuelled carnage. Grab your goblin crew and dive into the chaos!

FEATURES

  • Chaotic Goblin Antics
    Trip, throw, or ragdoll your way through interactive environments full of danger, comedy, and pure goblin energy.

  • Competitive & Co-op Mini-Games
    Face off in wild versus modes or work together (badly) in team-based challenges. From being roped together to racing for the finish, mayhem is guaranteed.

  • Physics-Driven Gameplay
    Every obstacle and interactable is powered by absurd physics, making every round unpredictable and hilarious. You'll never play the same round twice!

  • Custom Goblins 
    Accessorize your gobbo with hats, shades, and more. Express yourself—poorly.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

Whether you’re tripping over your own feet, tossing teammates off buildings, or hanging on for dear life, GOBSMACKED! delivers fast, funny, and endlessly chaotic fun. You’re not just playing as goblins-you’re embracing the chaos of goblins: stubborn, wobbly, and wildly unpredictable. It’s perfect for game nights, party sessions, and shouting at your friends when they “accidentally” drop you. Whether you’re working together in co-op or betraying each other in versus mode, every moment is packed with ridiculous, replayable nonsense—and yes, that’s a good thing. Nothing breaks faster than a goblin with a box and bad ideas. GOBSMACKED! doesn’t take itself seriously - except when it comes to fun.
